## In this module

Five interactive books, following data through a project from collection to analysis. You can still open any of them on its own.

1. [Collecting Primary Data](#collecting-primary-data)
2. [Secondary Data Collection](#secondary-data-collection)

4. [Quantitative Data Analysis](#quantitative-data-analysis)
5. [Qualitative Data Analysis](#qualitative-data-analysis)
:::
